Agent response: That's a great follow-up question! Beyond choosing the right food, there are a few key things beginners often find helpful to know to ensure a smooth start for both them and their dog: Transitioning Your Dog: It's very important to gradually introduce any new food to your dog's diet to avoid digestive upset. We have a guide on Transitioning to Fresh Food that walks you through the process. Feeding Guides: Knowing how much to feed your dog is crucial for their health and weight management. Our Feeding Guides provide general recommendations, and our Feeding Calculator can help you create a personalized meal plan. Food Storage: Proper storage ensures the food stays fresh and safe. Here's a quick overview: Fresh Frozen Meals: Thawed food (excluding fish-based recipes) stays fresh in the refrigerator for up to 7 days in an unopened package, and 5 days once opened. Fish-based meals last up to 5 days unopened and 3 days once opened. Cooked foods thawed by the cold-water method should never be refrozen. JustFresh Products: These are shelf-stable for up to 2 years unopened. Once opened, store in the refrigerator and use within 3 days. Pantry Fresh Products: Also shelf-stable for up to 2 years unopened. Once opened, store in the refrigerator and use within 5 days. Treats & Supplements: Chicken Breast Treats, Venison Treats, Beef Brisket Treats, Omega Marine Microalgae Oil, and Omega Plus Fish Oil should all be stored in the refrigerator after opening. General Information: Our Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) page is a great resource for understanding more about our ingredients, how our food is balanced, and other common questions. Taking these steps will help you and your dog get the most out of JustFoodForDogs! Would you like to talk to one of our Nutrition Consultants?
